messages:
Nora (Marketing): Quick sync 11 — were launching the "Morning Tilt" newsletter next week. Need final audience splits, a short resend path for non-openers, and the demo-click routing. Draft and list rules: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/morning-tilt.

Diego (Growth): Proposal: primary cohort = trials active in last 21d (50%), secondary = users with product usage but no trial (20%), third = dormant leads (20%), 10% external partners/integrations. Add engagement boost: +15% weight to anyone who opened an email in last 60d.

Rina (Content): I compressed the hero to one stat + 2 bullets. Subjects to test: "Morning Tilt: speed up your LLM responses" vs "See measurable latency drops with our new flow". Preheaders: short vs benefit. Will trim CTAs to Docs / Quick demo.

Felix (Deliverability): ESP limit reminder: safe velocity 95k/hr. Plan a staggered rollout: NA -> EMEA -> APAC over 40h. Seed send 1k tomorrow 09:00 PT. If hard bounces >1.2% in first 20m pause and switch remainder to a 3-email drip at 72h intervals. Will export suppression lists (global_unsub, trial_hard_optout, dedicated_customers).

Nora (Marketing): For routing: demo_click event should post to webhook /webhooks/campaigns with utm params. If lead intent_score >= 65 tag as hot and route to #sdr-priority. Anyone with AE assigned or enterprise flag = true should be excluded from auto-routing.

Diego (Growth): UTMs: utm_campaign=morning_tilt_launch&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Measurement windows: demo conversions 7d, docs events 14d. Also keep a 3% randomized holdback for lift analysis.

Rina (Content): Small note: include a short testimonial line in second fold for the reminder send. Also drafting alternate subject for 72h resend that leans on urgency.

campaign-bot: Workspace updated: "morning-tilt-newsletter". Review meeting scheduled: tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Felix (Deliverability): Actionables: I'll push suppression export today and run seed tomorrow. Alerts go to #deliverability and #release-war-room. Setting retry policy: after pause, resume at 25% velocity and ramp 4x.

Nora (Marketing): Tasks: Rina finalize subjects + resend copy (EOD), Felix export lists + run seed (today/tomorrow), Diego configure routing + UTMs (tomorrow AM). Ping me for any blocker. :rocket:
